# Documentation

Update the smallest relevant document whenever behavior, setup, schema, provider, cost, or security changes. Keep commands copyable, distinguish verified facts from decisions, record provider pricing/quotas with a date and source, and keep `.env.example` free of real secrets. Link to the BRD rather than duplicating it.
